content.name: Action Surge
entries: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the {@action Magic|SRD52} action.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.
